description: This file defines the UsersPage React component, which displays a list of users with actions to view their project activity via a modal. It uses hooks for state management and effects, and integrates multiple internal components such as Card, DataTable, Button, and UserProjectsModal, as well as an API call to list users.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user data from the API, updates component state with the results or error message.
